summary: Distinct one-character strings cause unsigned subtraction underflow when jaro calculates its search range, panicking with overflow checks enabled; jaro_winkler inherits the panic. The original max(0, ...) cannot prevent underflow during argument evaluation. This fix returns 0.0 before that calculation for distinct one-character inputs; identical strings already return 1.0. Contrary to the imported description, this commit does not use saturating_sub. The selected regression test was added by the fix. No tests were run.
